source.text: Participants have histologically-confirmed unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumors which exhibit the PIK3CA H1047R mutation in tumor tissue and/or blood (circulating tumor deoxyribonucleic acid \[ctDNA\]).

For Phase 1A and planned monotherapy cohorts in Phase 1B, participants have experienced progressive disease, relapsed disease, or be intolerant to at least one established standard systemic anti-cancer treatment for a given tumor type, or in the opinion of the Investigator have been considered ineligible for standard therapy.
